$schemaComment: Migration / deployment compatibility registry. SSOT for expand|neutral|contract phases. Docs: docs/database-workflow.md

20260730113000.notes: Creates SECURITY DEFINER public RSVP RPCs. Historical outage paired this with DML revoke before app cutover.

20260730220544.notes: Qualifies extensions.gen_random_bytes for hybrid create under search_path=public.

20260802090000.notes: Creates durable single-use Production authorization receipt table for owner workflows.

20260804170000.notes: Drops the retired one-time legacy adoption RPC. Blocked until the replacement client proves it no longer depends on that function.

20260805143000.notes: Adds immutable managed_identity_id + previous_slugs lineage and enforces archive cascade deactivation of dependents.

20260806120000.notes: Creates shared Preview release-approval store (cross-worktree SSOT for promote).

20260812210000.notes: Idempotent reconcile of idx_guest_invitations_phone and guest_invitations_phone_country_code_pair_check across Local/Preview/Production starting states.

20260828000000.notes: Creates the private Valentina Memories catalog and replaces any pre-existing service-role policies with the canonical definitions.

20260829000100.notes: Replaces the initial status and checksum constraints with duplicate-aware catalog integrity constraints.

20260829000200.notes: Restricts the catalog and lifecycle RPCs to service_role while adding atomic reservation, validation, cleanup, and audit behavior.

20260829171814.notes: Replaces the reservation RPC signature with the canonical per-session video quota parameter.

20260901000000.notes: Removes legacy client-side privilege paths, drops historical permissive event policies in favor of canonical active-record RLS, and restricts tenant-write/claim routines to service_role.

20260905000000.notes: Revokes direct client reads for published invitation JSON and direct DML on BFF-owned invitation/intake resources; reapplies the create-only RSVP RPC with extensions.gen_random_bytes under search_path=public.

20260907230000.notes: Replaces the WebP-only CHECK with a superset accepting validated original JPEG/PNG. Existing rows and rendered content remain unchanged; pin deployed app identity before hosted apply and publish originals only with the updated validator.

20260908212231.notes: Creates atomic session anonymization RPC and revokes execution privileges from public/anon/authenticated.

20260910160000.notes: Adds administrative metadata and replaces authenticated table-wide INSERT/UPDATE with grants on existing columns. Hosted apply requires deployed-app evidence that invitation writes use explicit existing columns or the server service role. Invitation-specific initialization is separately authorized.

20260925182713.notes: Adds administrator-only append-only demo milestones. Application reports unavailability until explicitly authorized guarded migration apply.

20260911070000.notes: Drops the drained seven-argument publication overload after all application and provisioning callers moved to the concurrency-safe current contract.

20260930180000.notes: Creates the event-neutral guest memories catalog (settings, sessions, items, audit) with service-role-only access and per-event window, retention and quotas enforced inside the reservation RPC. Additive for the application: legacy valentina_* objects stay until the separately authorized retirement migration, which requires the event_memories_client capability.

20261001120000.notes: Creates the service-role-only soft_delete_guest_invitation_v1 RPC used by the dashboard guest delete. The only revoke initializes privileges of the new function; table grants and RLS policies are unchanged. Apply before deploying the application that calls it.

20261002012428.notes: Adds nullable administrator-only planning columns (expected_guests, admin_note) to event_memory_settings. The reservation RPC and the access boundary are unchanged. Must be applied before the application that selects these columns.

20261006120000.notes: Adds nullable hidden_at, thumbnail_object_key and thumbnail_bytes to event_memory_items and share_version (default 0) plus share_enabled_at to event_memory_settings. No RPC, grant or RLS change. Must be applied before the application that selects these columns.

20261009220000.notes: Adds events.branding_removal_guest_limit (default 0) and backfills the one event sold with the add-on. Apply before deploying the application that selects the column.

20261010120000.notes: Adds the append-only guest_engagement_events ledger, per-guest engagement projections and is_test on guest_invitations, events.event_date with its publish trigger and backfill, the service-role ingestion RPC, the host summary RPC, and narrows the guest audit trigger to the first view. Revokes only initialize privileges of the new table and functions. Apply before deploying the application that records engagement events.

20261010130000.notes: Adds the permanent invitation_engagement_snapshots table and the service-role snapshot candidate, snapshot compute and ledger anonymization functions. Revokes only initialize privileges of the new table and functions. Apply before deploying the application whose maintenance cron calls them.

20261010180000.notes: Redefines publish_invitation_atomic so a publication keeps an archived (RSVP disabled) linked event archived instead of resetting it to published. Same signature, grants and receipts; the deployed application does not depend on the old reset.

20261012200000.notes: Drops claim codes, the client capture tables and their unused event/project helpers, redefines the archive/delete/restore helpers without them and narrows invitations.status. Apply only after the application without self-registration or capture is deployed; export the three tables first.

20261012200100.notes: Drops the RSVP v1 store, the legacy adoption receipts and host_profiles, none of which the application reads. Apply after the application that no longer writes host_profiles is deployed; export the five tables first.

20261012200200.notes: Drops the client-named Valentina memories catalog and its RPCs. Export the three tables and the referenced storage objects first; object deletion is a separate owner step.

20261013100000.notes: Adds the service-role-only invitation_access_controls table (payment status and public access per invitation), the insert trigger on invitations that creates each row unpaid and enabled, and the set_invitation_access_control RPC that writes audit_logs. Backfills every existing invitation as paid and enabled, so nothing visible changes. Revokes only initialize privileges of the new table and functions. Apply before deploying the application that reads it.

20261013110000.notes: Drops track_guest_invitation_view_public, the legacy view telemetry RPC. The application records guest engagement through record_guest_engagement_events_public and no longer serves /api/invitacion/:inviteId/view. Apply only after the Production deployment that provides guest_engagement_only_client passed smoke.

20261013120000.notes: Adds list_invitation_engagement_ranking, a service-role-only read routine over invitation_engagement_snapshots that applies the engagement comparison rules (same event type, final over rolling, 20-guest sample threshold, design group sizes). Additive: the admin ranking API tolerates its absence. Revokes only initialize privileges of the new function.

20261013150000.notes: Adds list_invitation_engagement_ranking_v2, a service-role-only read routine over every published client invitation: live guest aggregates (responses by source, inferred opens, response rate) joined to the chosen engagement snapshot, event status, activity state, public access, confirmation mode and design. Additive: the v1 routine stays until the v2 client is deployed. Revokes only initialize privileges of the new function.

20261014120000.notes: Drops list_invitation_engagement_ranking (v1) and the invitation_projects compatibility view. The admin ranking reads list_invitation_engagement_ranking_v2 and no application path reads the view. Apply only after the Production deployment that serves the v2 ranking client passed smoke.

20261014150000.notes: Redefines publish_invitation_atomic (same eleven-argument signature, security invoker, empty search_path and grants) so p_public_metadata_hash may be either the legacy baseline (with baseDemoId and snapshot) or the current baseline (archivedAt, eventType, kind, slug, status, themeId, title), and drops submissionId from the result draft. Gives invitations.base_demo_id an empty-string default so inserts can omit it. The deployed application keeps publishing with the legacy hash. Apply before deploying the application that sends the current hash; the column contract that drops base_demo_id, snapshot and submission_id comes later.

20261015120000.notes: Drops invitations.base_demo_id, invitations.snapshot and invitation_content_drafts.submission_id. Redefines publish_invitation_atomic to accept only the current public-metadata baseline (archivedAt, eventType, kind, slug, status, themeId, title), and save_invitation_metadata_atomic and restore_invitation_from_published_atomic to insert drafts without submission_id; signatures and grants are unchanged. Apply only after the Production deployment that claims legacy_invitation_columns_retired_client passed smoke.

20261015220000.notes: Replaces invitation_assets_provider_valid and invitation_assets_cloudinary_fields_complete with supersets so invitation_assets.provider also accepts 'r2', with the same provider_public_id and secure_url requirement as Cloudinary rows. Registered as contract only because the CHECK swap uses DROP CONSTRAINT; both checks are re-added NOT VALID and only widen, so no rows, URLs or asset bytes change and the deployed application keeps working. Apply before any task that writes R2 asset rows.

20261017120000.notes: Adds invitation_engagement_historical_estimates (one row per event and method version, aggregates only, RLS forced, service-role select), compute_engagement_historical_estimates (computes method version 1 once from legacy viewed audit rows before 2026-10-12 16:25 UTC; re-running a version is a no-op) and list_engagement_historical_estimates (service-role read over published client invitations). The migration computes version 1 in its body. Additive: the deployed application keeps working and the historical view answers 503 until this routine exists. Revokes only initialize privileges of the new objects.

20261018120000.notes: Adds platform_usage_snapshots (one row per provider dataset per collector run: collected_at, provider, ok, payload jsonb; aggregates only), indexed by collected_at, RLS forced with no policies, service-role select/insert/delete. Additive: the deployed application never reads it yet, and the Production collector cron only writes once this table exists (until then each run logs a failed insert). Revokes only initialize privileges of the new object.

20261018180000.notes: Adds public.platform_database_size() (security definer, empty search_path, returns pg_database_size of the current database; reads no table), executable by service_role only. Additive: the Production collector cron stores its result as a supabase_database snapshot once it exists (until then that dataset logs a failed RPC). Revokes only initialize privileges of the new function.

20261019180000.notes: Narrows invitation_assets_provider_valid to ('supabase', 'r2') for live rows and replaces invitation_assets_cloudinary_fields_complete with invitation_assets_remote_fields_complete (same object key and secure URL rule, live R2 rows only); soft-deleted rows (deleted_at set) may keep the retired provider. Both checks are added validated. Aborts without changing rows if any live provider='cloudinary' row remains. The application no longer reads or writes Cloudinary rows. Apply after 20261015220000 and never in the same release as a newly published invitation.

20261020120000.notes: Adds guest_invitations.guest_code (4 characters from an alphabet without 0/o/1/l/i, unique per event_id, NOT NULL after backfill), generate_guest_code(uuid) and a BEFORE INSERT trigger that assigns the code on every insert path under a per-event advisory lock. Backfills every existing guest, soft-deleted rows included. Additive: short_id and /i/{short_id} are untouched, and the deployed application keeps inserting guests without naming the column. Revokes only initialize privileges of the new functions. Must be applied before the application that reads guest_code is deployed.

20261020130000.notes: Adds events.guest_code_links (boolean, NOT NULL). Existing events get false, then the default turns true so events created afterwards opt in; america and olivia-y-antonio are set to true. Additive: the deployed application does not read the column. Apply together with 20261020120000, before the application that reads it is deployed.

20261024180000.notes: Adds visitor_sessions.client_ip_address and client_user_agent (nullable, length-checked) and keeps their first value in the first-touch trigger. Additive: the deployed application does not name the columns. Must be applied before the application that writes them is deployed, because PostgREST rejects unknown columns on the session upsert.

20261025120000.notes: Lets meta_conversion_events hold browser Contact and Lead rows: adds session_id (no foreign key) and event_source_path, drops NOT NULL on order_id, customer_id and value, widens the event_name and trigger_status checks, and adds a shape check that keeps Purchase rows as strict as before. Also adds visitor_consent_withdrawals, the record_visitor_marketing_withdrawal RPC and a visitor_sessions insert/update trigger that keeps a marketing withdrawal until a strictly newer consent decision. Registered as contract only because the check swaps use DROP CONSTRAINT and DROP NOT NULL; every change widens, so no rows change and the deployed application keeps working. Must be applied before the application that enqueues Contact and Lead rows is deployed, or those inserts fail (ingestion logs and continues).
